title: 💠 **Brigadier General Talaei-Nik: Upgrading missile warheads according to threats is a permanent priority of the defense industry.**
text:
💠 **Brigadier General Talaei-Nik: Upgrading missile warheads according to threats is a permanent priority of the defense industry.**"

"🔹 The spokesperson for the Ministry of Defense announced the continued process of enhancing strategic armaments—such as ballistic and cruise missiles—relying on domestic expertise. He stated that during the recent war, the use of effective and cost-efficient weaponry secured battlefield superiority for Iran."

"🔹 The production of weapons and ammunition in the Islamic Republic of Iran has never halted; the production cycle has consistently continued before, during, and after the war."

"🔹 Past experience demonstrates that should the enemy commit any further acts of folly, it will encounter even greater restrictions and setbacks.
